description: This is a header file (.h) that declares the API functions for the Http Ato CgiEnv object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions, used within an HTTP implementation for the BroadWay Service Delivery System.

methods.name: HttpCreateAtoCgiEnv
methods.description: Creates a new Http Ato CgiEnv object, taking container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvCreate
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Http Ato CgiEnv object with specified context and reserved handles.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the specified Http Ato CgiEnv object.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the associated objects within the Http Ato CgiEnv instance.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Http Ato CgiEnv object.
